title: Service Contracts: quarterly re-indexing of an index-linked base rate
content:
## Scope
This policy of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts product governs the quarterly re-indexing of the base rate of an index-linked contract against the line's published freight index for the contract's lane. Fixed-rate contracts are outside it.

## Formal clauses
1. An index-linked contract's base rate is re-indexed at the start of each contract quarter against the line's published freight index for the lane.
2. When the index moved by no more than the tier's index band percent over the previous quarter, no adjustment is made and nothing is recorded.
3. Beyond the band, the base rate changes by the tier's pass-through percent of the whole index movement applied to the base rate, capped at the tier's cap per FEU up or down, and the signed change per FEU is recorded for the quarter.
4. Fixed-rate contracts are never re-indexed.
5. An adjustment may be booked only on a contract that is active or suspended.

## Calculation steps
1. Take the index movement over the previous quarter, in percent, up or down.
2. If its size is not more than the band, stop: no adjustment, nothing recorded.
3. Otherwise multiply the base rate by the whole index movement and then by the pass-through share.
4. Limit the result to the cap per FEU, for a rise and for a fall alike.
5. Record the signed change per FEU for the quarter: a rise as a positive change, a fall as a negative one.

## Worked cases (hypothetical: base rate 1800 USD per FEU; illustrative band 6 %, pass-through 75 %, cap 120 USD per FEU)
| Index movement | Band test | Change before the cap | Change recorded |
|---|---|---|---|
| up 4 % | within the band | none | no adjustment |
| up 6 % | not more than the band | none | no adjustment |
| up 6.5 % | beyond the band | 1800 multiplied by 6.5 % and by 75 %, a rise of 87.75 | rise of 87.75 USD per FEU |
| up 8 % | beyond the band | 1800 multiplied by 8 % and by 75 %, a rise of 108.00 | rise of 108.00 USD per FEU |
| down 10 % | beyond the band | 1800 multiplied by 10 % and by 75 %, a fall of 135.00 | fall of 120.00 USD per FEU (capped) |

**Wrong reading: passing through only the movement beyond the band.** For the 8 % rise, passing through only the 2 % above the band would give 27.00 USD per FEU. The clause applies the pass-through share to the whole index movement, giving 108.00 USD per FEU.

## Contract status and rate basis
| Situation | Adjustment may be booked |
|---|---|
| index-linked, active | yes |
| index-linked, suspended | yes |
| index-linked, pending signature, expired or terminated | no |
| fixed rate, any status | never re-indexed |
